description: This file defines the SupportsMetadataColumns interface in the Spark SQL connector, which allows tables to expose additional metadata columns not present in the schema, and handles conflicts between data and metadata column names.

classes.name: SupportsMetadataColumns
classes.description: An interface for exposing additional metadata columns in a table, with methods to retrieve supported metadata columns and handle name conflicts.

methods.name: metadataColumns
methods.description: Returns an array of MetadataColumn objects representing the metadata columns supported by the table.

methods.name: canRenameConflictingMetadataColumns
methods.description: Indicates whether the data source supports automatically renaming metadata columns to resolve name conflicts with data columns.
